body: Joint Meeting: Glendale City Council and Glendale Housing Authority
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  JOINT MEETING: GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL AND GLENDALE HOUSING AUTHORITY
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  JUNE 24, 2025

ROLL CALL
  - 2:00 PM
  - Report of the City Clerk of the City Council and Housing Authority, re: Posting of Agenda.
  The Agenda for the Tuesday, June 24, 2025 joint public meeting of the City Council and
  Housing Authority was posted on June 20, 2025, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

  TYPED 6/20/2025 1:19:56 PM
  06 24 25
  1  CC HA
   A JOINT PUBLIC MEETING of the City Council and Housing Authority is hereby called
  to meet at 2:00 PM on Tuesday, June 24, 2025, in the Council Chamber, 613 E. Broadway,
  2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;

  1. Community Development, re: Adoption of the FY 2025-26 Glendale Housing
  Authority Budget and Contract Amendments
  a. Resolution of the City Council Making Findings and Approving Expenditures of Low
  Moderate Income Housing Asset Funds for Administration and Planning and Expenditures
  Outside Redevelopment Project Areas for the FY 2025-26 Housing Authority Budget;
  b. Resolution of the Housing Authority Making Findings and Approving Expenditures of
  Low Moderate Income Housing Asset Funds for Administration and Planning and
  Expenditures Outside Redevelopment Project Areas for the FY 2025-26 Housing Authority
  Budget and Adopting the FY 2025-26 Housing Authority Budget;
  c. Motion of the Housing Authority to Approve an Amendment to the Professional Services
  Agreement with Kane, Ballmer and Berkman (Contract C106203) to Increase the Contract
  Amount by $300,000 for a New “Not to Exceed” Contract of $1,040,000 for Affordable
  Housing Legal Services; and to Extend the Agreement Term for Two Years to June 30,
  2027; and
  d. Motion to Approve Amendment to the Servicing Agreement between the Housing
  Authority of the City of Glendale and Heritage Housing Partners (Contract 8000078),
  Extending the Agreement Term for Two Years to June 30, 2027
  2. Community Development, re: Note and File the City of Glendale’s 2025 Homeless
  Point-in-Time Count
  a. Council Motion to Note and File the City of Glendale’s 2025 Homeless Point-in-Time
  Count
  b. Housing Authority Motion to Note and File the City of Glendale’s 2025 Homeless Point-
  in-Time Count
  3. Community Services and Parks, re: Regarding 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and FY
  2025-2026 Annual Action Plan for Community Development Block Grant (CDBG),
  Emergency Solutions Grant (ESG), and HOME Investment Partnerships Act (HOME)
  programs
  a. City Council Resolution Adopting an Environmental Negative Declaration
  b. City Council Motion to approve 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and authorizing
  submission to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
  c. City Council Motion to approve FY 2025-2026 CDBG, ESG, and HOME Annual Action
  Plan totaling $3,266,569.65; authorize the submission of the Annual Action Plan to U.S.
  Department of Housing and Urban Development, as recommended by the CDBG Advisory
  Committee and Continuum of Care Board (CoC); and authorize the City Manager or a
  designee, to redirect excess, cancelled or unused program funds under $50,000 from one
  project to another with CDBG Advisory Committee approval
  d. Housing Authority Motion to approve 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and authorize
  submission to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
  e. Housing Authority Motion to approve FY 2025-2026 CDBG, ESG, and HOME Annual
  Action Plan totaling $3,266,569.65; and authorize the submission of the Annual Action Plan
  to U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, as recommended by the CDBG
  Advisory Committee and Continuum of Care Board (CoC)

ADJOURNMENT

  TYPED 6/20/2025 1:19:56 PM
  06 24 25
  2  CC HA
   ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SERVICE
